response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS t WHERE t.ID = p.ID AND t.`U-PRO` = '-' AND t.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Both negative results occurred on the same lab record.

alternatives.interpretation: The two negative results may have occurred on different lab records for the same patient.
